notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and intake in progress. 175 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, all of Chapter Three (pp. 87-141/PDF 88-142, 94 Charms across all nine Charm trees plus the two General Charms and the Charm-system framing), and now the full Chapter Four weaving-protocol catalog (49 rows, printed pp. 142-159/PDF 143-160) that the Man-Machine Weaving Engine and God-Machine Weaving Engine Charms run through. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
